_comment: Labelled UNSTRUCTURED-entity corpus for M2 (Person / Organization / Location), IT + EN. Positive recall is measured once an ONNX NER model is wired (feature `onnx`) — see docs/M2-NER-EVALUATION.md. The negatives are REG-03 guards enforced NOW against the deterministic layer: structured recognizers must never guess a name/org/location. Values reuse the old proxy's scenarios (Pinco Pallino, Futura Incognita, single-word Tizio/Caia, the `anubi` false positive).

_multilingual_comment: M4 validation set — one Person + Location per XLM-R HRL language (ar, de, en, es, fr, it, lv, nl, pt, zh). EN/IT are covered in `entities` above; DE + the seven below round out the model's declared domain. Ground truth is the human label; the eval harness (tests/ner_eval.rs) measures how closely the model matches — see docs/DEVLOG.md for the recorded numbers.
